svg.aria-label: 〈情非得已〉 ("Against My Will") muted strum: ↓ - ✕ ↑ - ↑ ✕ ↑
svg.title: 〈情非得已〉 ("Against My Will") muted strum: ↓ - ✕ ↑ - ↑ ✕ ↑
svg.text: 〈情非得已〉 ("Against My Will") muted strum: ↓ - ✕ ↑ - ↑ ✕ ↑
✕ is the right-hand knife-edge mute, landing on beats 2 and 4; everywhere else strums down and up as usual
One box is one beat; when you change chords the right hand never stops, only the left hand moves
